Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
Hello all,

Am pleased to announce Amaranth: amaranth.vtes.co.nz

It started off as a tool to test the redesigned cards — but grew from there into a fully fledged deck building tool.

Features include:

Print full decks (new design and old cards)
Partial print decks (good for changes / old proxies)
Full text searching / easy filters
Import from: Secret Library (public)
Export to: Lackey, JOL, Text

There's a feedback icon on cards to report any issues with cards — more features to follow soon.

iOS and Android versions will also be released soon.

Screen shots below...

Messages.Author: 666Raziel
Messages.Body:
Ok, at first I thought about using the comment button, then I realize this might need a public debate.

Let's talk about Imbued cards in Ke's layout.

First : Conviction.

Since the best thing of this new template are the separate boxes for each effect, could you do the same for Conviction ?

For example :
>
> Second Sight
> >
> > > {Black Box}An imbued may burn only one Second Sight for the following effects each action.
> > >
> > >
> > >
> > > Burn when a monster is acting to give this imbued +1 intercept for that action.
> > >
> > >
> > >
> > > Burn when this imbued declares an action to give monsters -1 intercept for this action.
> > >
> > >
> >
> React with Conviction
> >
> > When an effect that would change control of this imbued is played or announced, you may burn this card to cancel that effect.
> >
> > Burn this card to cancel either a  action against this imbued that requires Chimerstry [chi], Dementation [dem], Dominate [dom], Presence [pr_], or Serpentis [ser] or a strike card that requires any of those Disciplines played by a minion opposing this imbued as it is announced. No cost is paid.
> >
> Strike with Conviction
> >
> > Burn to make a hand or weapon strike against a monster at +1 damage.
> >
> > Burn to bleed at +1 bleed as a  action.
> >
Second : Power.

When a Power gives an action that cost conviction, you placed the Conviction icon, below the Power requirement. (  See Inspire for example .) I don't know if this was done voluntarily or not, but this is very wrong.
Every Power should have the same template. And the cost of the ability they provide is always written after the type of the ability.

Third : Conviction Icon.

Now that we don't have cards icon anymore, there is something weird with this icon when it's used to indicate a cost. (Since, unlike blood and pool, it refers to a card type.)
Though it's not a "big" deal (only 18 cards are concerned), I think we should still find a solution for the sake of consistency.
So what can be done ?
- add the icon somewhere on conviction card ?
- rewrite the cards and replace those icon by full words (such as : "this imbued burn X conviction to ...") ?

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Hello!

Just discovered this, tried it out and shared to our local meta. Excellent work! Had to try it out, and the .pdfs print out wonderfully.

I'm loving the work you've done for the new layouts, but still kept the old ones as an option. Amaranth is now probably the most extensive database for VtES card images?

I don't know if the new layouts and their design are of any particular importance at the moment for you guys, but I'd love to add my two cents:

- the font is a bit on a 'times new roman' end. I'd work a bit on the spacing, and compress the text a bit more. The spacing (especially on library cards) is more like 1,5 or 1,7 by the looks of it, while it could easily be 1,2 or so.
- I sorta miss the ovality of the crypt cards. The idea is contemporary and fine, but I'd love to have something of the oval structure.
- in the same vein, the consistent green of the discipline bar in the official layout is something I really miss. Mixing clans makes for a bit of a mess atm. It does take a wee bit off of the 'more art' direction, which you guys seem to like, but a darker shade of oval borders around the crypt art would make for a bit more consistent layout in play (across clans).
- what I said above goes even more so for library cards. Blue for actions, red for combat, and the such is clear alright, but it leaves the design lacking in what I really love in grittiness of vampire art. It's even a bit 'too' clear, modern and 'clean'. I'm sure you know what I mean. Just a hint of extra borders, dark, ruggedness, at the expense of how much art is shown?

I can give more opinions on the layout if that's at all on your priority lists.  Suggestions, mind, not complaints at all!

The whole Amaranth project is great work, and greatly appreciated.

-P
